text: Round update: - Fixed Veria's quadratic-draining finding in 9fb4797be3. `pop_next_value` was rebuilding the full remaining string and slicing a new remainder on every call, making draining N concatenated values O(n^2). author: deepanshululla
text: Summary of this session's work, in order: Fixed a real Medium-severity leak Veria caught: a client disconnecting before the first streamed chunk bypassed both `async_log_success_event` and `async_log_failure_event`, so a queued concurrency reservation never got released except by its 1-hour safety TTL. Added an opt-in `async_release_disconnect_state_hook` on `CustomLogger`, wired into the proxy's disconnect cleanup, with `tag_rate_limiter` releasing pending reservations through it.
